Each of these PUTs returned 201: https://localhost./ (trailing dot also gets past .local and .internal), https://2130706433/, https://127.1/, https://0x7f000001/, https://0177.0.0.1/, https://0/, a fullwidth-letter localhost, and the IP literals [64:ff9b::a00:1] (NAT64 to 10.0.0.1), [::127.0.0.1] and [2002:7f00:1::]. tasks.behavior: Invoice changes become webhook events with a per-invoice sequence
acceptance: Each invoice change that an event names (detected, partially paid, paid, settled, expired, canceled, held with its reason) writes one event per endpoint that takes it, in the transaction that makes the change
An event's body has its id, type, livemode, the invoice's sequence number for it and the invoice as the API reads it

tasks.behavior: A delivery process sends signed webhooks with retries and an outbound filter
acceptance: A process with no signer key sends each event with Standard Webhooks headers signed by every working secret, through a filter that refuses private, loopback and metadata addresses after DNS
A failure retries on the Svix schedule for about 3 days; a redirect fails; 410 or the last failure disables the endpoint and emails the owner; each attempt is logged
R-148, api.md and architecture.md describe it; required checks pass
